name: Reviewer repository
covers: Steers work in neralabs/reviewer toward its architecture: who may write to GitHub, what the model may do, pure decision modules, and modules kept apart from the core.

rules.title: Write to GitHub only from post and respond

passes.text:
const write = new GitHub(requireEnv("APP_TOKEN"));
await write.request("POST", reviewsPath, { event: "COMMENT", body });

rules.title: Reach GitHub only through the GitHub class

passes.text: const res = await fetch(url, { method, headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${this.token}` } });

rules.title: Give the review model read-only tools only

passes.text:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ALLOWED_TOOLS (Read only); never Bash, Edit or Write
allowed_tools="${ALLOWED_TOOLS:-Read,Grep,Glob,Agent}"
claude -p "$p" \
  --restricted \
  --permission-mode dontAsk \
  --allowedTools "$allowed_tools" \
  --disallowedTools "Edit,Write,NotebookEdit,WebFetch,WebSearch,ScheduleWakeup"

rules.title: Show callers pull_request_target and named secrets only

caught.text:
name: reviewer
on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize]
jobs:
  reviewer:
    uses: neralabs/reviewer/.github/workflows/review.yml@v1.2.0

passes.text:
on:
  # pull_request_target, not pull_request:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [review_requested]
  pull_request_review_comment:
    types: [created]
jobs:
  reviewer:
    # Name each secret instead of `secrets: inherit`.
    secrets:
      REVIEWER_APP_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.REVIEWER_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
